description: This source file defines the IOQueue class, which manages work items using a concurrent queue and thread pool scheduling. It implements a custom queue scheduler and thread pool work item interface, facilitating asynchronous work execution in a networking context.

classes.name: IOQueue
classes.description: A sealed class that schedules and executes work items asynchronously using a concurrent queue and thread pool, designed for internal networking operations.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Enqueues a work item and triggers scheduling if not already scheduled.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs queued work items, manages scheduling state, and ensures thread-safe execution.
